summary.key_theme: 市場高度關注 Tesla 新一代 Roadster 的發布與 SpaceX 合併傳聞，同時市場正屏息等待即將公布的 Q3 財報以驗證 AI 與自動駕駛業務的獲利能力。

bullish.title: Tesla unveils new Roadster — CNBC's Phil LeBeau reports on Tesla's upcoming Roadster model, featuring innovative rocket thruster technology.
bullish.reason: Roadster 的亮相展示了 Tesla 在技術創新上的領先地位，特別是火箭推進技術，被視為吸引高端買家的「光環車款」，有助於提升品牌形象。

bullish.title: Prediction market odds on Tesla-SpaceX merger are above 50% for early 2027 — Kalshi odds for a Tesla-SpaceX merger rose above 50% for early 2027 as Barclays outlined how a deal could work.
bullish.reason: 市場對於 Tesla 與 SpaceX 合併的預期升溫，若成真將產生巨大的協同效應，整合航太與電動車技術，對股價具有強大的想像空間。

bullish.title: Sam Altman praises the Tesla Roadster he gave up on — The two tech titans have fought in court and online. A single post may have just changed the tone.
bullish.reason: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 對 Roadster 的正面評價具有指標性意義，有助於修復與科技界領袖的關係，並提升產品的市場認可度。

bearish.title: US Appeals Court Overturns Class Action Lawsuit Over Tesla Self-Driving Claims — Key Stats for Tesla StockPrice change for Tesla stock in the last 6 months: -11%$TSLA Stock Price as of Oct. 16: $35552-
bearish.reason: 儘管部分訴訟被推翻，但關於自動駕駛（FSD）的法律爭議持續存在，這對 Tesla 的技術信譽與監管風險構成長期壓力。

bearish.reason: 中國收緊太陽能製造技術出口，可能對 Tesla 的能源業務供應鏈造成潛在的成本上升或技術獲取障礙。

neutral.title: Meta, Tesla Q3 earnings will be fighting rising AI skepticism — The tech giants’ results will be the week’s biggest in a volatile market.
neutral.reason: 市場正處於對 AI 投資回報的懷疑期，Q3 財報將是決定股價短期走勢的關鍵，目前市場情緒觀望，故列為中性。

neutral.title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Tesla, SpaceX, Alcoa, CoreWeave, Travelers & more — These are the stocks posting the largest moves premarket.
neutral.reason: 僅為盤前交易波動的例行報導，未包含具體基本面變動，對長期股價影響有限。
